paper: Combined spectral and speech features for pig speech recognition
dataset: Sow Call dataset; paper reports 4000 clips
feature: MFCC; Log-Mel; chroma; spectral contrast; tonnetz; MC/LMC/MLMC
backbone: EfficientNetB1 spectrogram branch plus RNN/LSTM/GRU branch and LR/SVM classifier
evaluation_split: test result reported; exact membership, seed, animal/session grouping, and source disjointness not reported
reported_value: headline accuracy=0.9339; separate confusion-matrix test visualization=0.9452; AUC=0.99163
overlap_with_our_work: pig-specific fixed 2 s input and overlapping calm/feeding/frightened/anxious states
key_difference: no shared main/subtype supervision; no prototypes; split provenance and F1 averaging do not match ours

paper: Domestic pig sound classification based on TransformerCNN
dataset: Sow Call dataset; paper reports 4000 clips
feature: MFCC; Log-Mel; chroma; spectral contrast; tonnetz; MC/LMC/MLMC; selected MLMC 145x55
backbone: parallel two-layer five-head Transformer encoder and four-layer CNN
evaluation_split: single clip-level 80/20 split: 800 train and 200 test per class; no animal/session grouping reported
reported_value: accuracy=0.9605; AUC=0.9837; recall=0.9052; precision=0.9080; F1=0.9047; MLMC-table F1=0.9064
overlap_with_our_work: same named public source, fixed duration, and four behavioral labels targeted by a possible replication benchmark
key_difference: local corpus and exact split are not recoverable; no hierarchy/prototypes; metric and split differ

paper: Classification of pig calls produced from birth to slaughter according to their emotional valence and context of production
dataset: 7414 low-noise modeled calls from 411 pigs and 19 contexts, drawn from a larger multi-laboratory collection
input_duration: variable calls; CNN spectrograms zero-padded to 3.595 s
feature: handcrafted acoustic variables for pDFA; 3 ms-window spectrogram for CNN
hierarchical_labels: no; LF/HF preprocessing is not a supervised label hierarchy
evaluation_split: random call-level 70/30 train/validation repeated 10 times; no independent source-disjoint test
key_difference: different corpus, labels, duration, sample unit, split, and metric
citation_verified: yes; Scientific Reports publisher and DOI 10.1038/s41598-022-07174-8

paper: A multi-stage ensemble framework for classifying pig vocalizations under noisy animal farm environments (PVMC)
dataset: four datasets; final contextual set contains 1650 imbalanced clips described as sourced from Liao
input_duration: 0.2 s segmentation; 1 s coarse stages; 1.9-2.5 s final contextual clips
feature: mel/linear spectrogram and MFCC; Log-Mel; raw waveform
backbone: SEGAN+; compact CNN; SqueezeNet; AST plus Wav2Vec2 soft voting
reported_value: segmentation accuracy=0.9580; coarse accuracy=0.9888; final ensemble F1=0.9201, recall=0.9215, precision=0.9213; abstract calls 0.9215 accuracy
overlap_with_our_work: closest pig-specific coarse-to-fine class topology and noisy-farm motivation
key_difference: separately trained pipeline stages, different subsets and sample units, no shared representation or prototypes
citation_verified: yes; Scientific Reports publisher and DOI 10.1038/s41598-025-17205-9

paper: HiSSNet: Sound Event Detection and Speaker Identification via Hierarchical Prototypical Networks for Low-Resource Headphones
dataset: seven datasets; about 211600 files and 673.4 h
auxiliary_supervision: yes; weighted sum of hierarchy-level losses
prototype_inference: yes; support means and meta-prototypes with distance inference
post_hoc_prototype: no; prototypes are integral to episodic end-to-end training
top_k_candidates: hierarchy-level candidate sets, but no reported ranked top-k class output
open_set_or_few_shot: few-shot episodic; paper recommends future open-set handling but does not evaluate rejection
evaluation_split: random stratified 10 folds: 9 for cross-validation training and 1 post-training evaluation fold; all evaluation classes seen
overlap_with_our_work: closest precedent for joint hierarchy-level supervision plus prototype inference
key_difference: non-pig 1 s SEID; episodic/end-to-end prototypes; no post-hoc train-only prototype layer or retrieval
citation_verified: yes; official arXiv 2303.07538 and IEEE DOI 10.1109/ICASSP49357.2023.10094788

paper: AudioProtoPNet: An interpretable deep learning model for bird sound classification
dataset: BirdSet XCL training: 9734 species and over 6800 h; POW validation; seven geographic test sets
post_hoc_prototype: yes in the relevant sense: a conventional backbone is trained first, then frozen while the prototype head is fitted
top_k_candidates: no ranked class top-k; K=5 refers to retrieved training examples
representative_sample_retrieval: yes; top-K similar training instances and spectrogram patches per prototype
evaluation_split: XCL train, POW validation, seven separate geographic test sets; five seeds; validation-loss checkpoint selection
reported_value: seven-test mean AUROC=0.90; cmAP=0.42; top-1=0.62; SSW AUROC=0.97
overlap_with_our_work: strongest precedent for frozen-representation prototype inference and training-example retrieval
key_difference: bird multi-label task; flat prototypes; no main/subtype hierarchy or auxiliary supervision
citation_verified: yes; ScienceDirect publisher DOI 10.1016/j.ecoinf.2025.103081 and official arXiv 2404.10420

prototype_inference: yes; class mean of support embeddings and softmax over distances
post_hoc_prototype: no; prototypes are formed inside episodic training/evaluation
top_k_candidates: N-way candidate set, but no separate reported top-k output
open_set_or_few_shot: few-shot unseen-class meta-testing and zero-shot extension; not open-set rejection
evaluation_split: miniImageNet 64 train, 16 validation, 20 test classes; 600 test episodes
overlap_with_our_work: foundational class-mean prototype and distance-inference formulation

paper: Few-shot bioacoustic event detection at the DCASE 2022 challenge
dataset: predefined DCASE development and held-out evaluation datasets from multiple recording projects
task_labels: detect later onsets/offsets after first five positive target events
feature: challenge systems used spectrogram, Log-Mel, PCEN, and learned embeddings
backbone: overview; baselines include template matching and adaptive-segment ResNet ProtoNet
prototype_inference: yes for ProtoNet baseline and many submissions
top_k_candidates: few-shot target candidate, but no ranked top-k class output
open_set_or_few_shot: yes; five-shot event detection; not open-set rejection
reported_metric: event-level macro F-measure with 30% IoU and bipartite matching
reported_value: best evaluation=0.6022; ProtoNet baseline evaluation=0.0530 and validation=0.2845; template baseline evaluation=0.1235
key_difference: event detection, variable events, different species/data, and incompatible metric/sample unit
citation_verified: yes; official DCASE 2022 proceedings and official arXiv 2207.07911

paper: A Conformer-Based Time-Frequency Decoupling Network for Pig Vocalization Behavior Classification
dataset: commercial-farm five-class dataset with grouped cross-validation and an independent test
input_duration: not matched to our fixed 2 s protocol
feature: Log-Mel with spectral gating and time-frequency attention
backbone: time-frequency-decoupled Conformer with masked temporal pooling and AAM-Softmax
overlap_with_our_work: recent pig classification under grouped evaluation

paper: Improving pig audio signal recognition via integrated underdetermined blind source separation and deep learning
task_labels: four pig vocalization sources; eating/howling/humming outputs described
input_duration: not reported as a matched 2 s clip protocol
feature: blind source separation followed by spectrograms
hierarchical_labels: no; hierarchical clustering is a source-separation operation, not hierarchical labels
evaluation_split: study-specific split not aligned to ours
overlap_with_our_work: pig sound classification and noisy/group-housing motivation

paper: Robustness of CNN-Based model assessment for pig vocalization classification across diverse acoustic environments

evaluation_split: 10-fold within-farm evaluation and train-on-two/test-on-one unseen-farm evaluation

paper: Hierarchical Acoustic Encoding Distress in Pigs: Disentangling Individual, Developmental, and Emotional Effects with Subject-Wise Validation
dataset: 2221 vocal samples from 40 pigs across growth phases and distress conditions
task_labels: pain; hunger; thirst; cold stress; heat stress; normal
feature: Praat acoustic measures: energy, duration, intensity, pitch, formants
backbone: Random Forest plus mixed-model variance analysis
hierarchical_labels: no neural label hierarchy; hierarchical refers to biological variance structure
overlap_with_our_work: pig distress classification and rigorous subject-wise grouping
key_difference: handcrafted-feature six-condition task; no shared neural auxiliary supervision or prototypes
